text.description_html:
4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Square Corner Solid Brass Ball Bearing Hinge, Baldwin, 1046.050.I

Baldwin hinges are made from extruded brass machined for precise installation and smooth movement. They are beveled on the inside leaf to obtain a tight fit when viewing the hinge in a closed position and furnished with stainless steel, rustproof pins for added durability.

Package includes one hinge and 16 matching solid brass undercut flat head, Phillips Drive #12 x 1.25" wood screws.

Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corner: Square
  • Thickness: 0.130"
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: 16 ea. #12 x 1.25" Phillips
  • Hinge Material: Solid Brass

*Sold Individually
